body.name: B Cannon
body.description:
B Cannon is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are moving around the screen and can reverse your direction by pressing a button. Your goal is to shoot the circles that are bouncing around. You aim automatically and shoot at the current aim position. Hold a button to shoot. The circles break up into smaller ones and you have to shoot them until they can no longer be broken down.

The game is over when you touch any circle.

body.name: B Math
body.description:
B MATH is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to select which one of the five numbers is the correct for the equation. You have limited time for your answer. The faster you answer, the more points you'll score. After every correct answer you get a score multiplier. After every incorrect answer, you lose some time.

The game will end when the time runs out.
